name: Caihong Display Devices Co.,Ltd.
summary: Caihong Display Devices Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of substrate glass and display panels in China and internationally. The company offers TFT-LCD liquid crystal substrate glasses, liquid crystal glass panels, and other glass products and related products, as well as modules and supporting products, and new display devices and components, etc. It is also involved in the production, processing, and operation of electronic glass products; real estate development, property management, garden landscape design, site, and house leasing; and sale of non-metallic minerals and products, as well as provision of early childhood care and education services.
